opportunities.name: Resistance AD shell boxer
opportunities.objective: Test resistance ad shell boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Spiked Shell currently grants AD equal to 15% armor plus 15% MR, rather than the historical magic on-hit passive; Defensive Ball Curl raises both resistances for seven seconds. Jak'Sho and dual resistances therefore support own physical attacks, while Blade and Terminus add mixed packets.
opportunities.requiredState: W active with a target forced to attack by E.
opportunities.failure: Without attack speed from old E assumptions, target access limits the damage.
opportunities.test: Record AD before W, during W and after Jak'Sho then measure three attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The old armor-to-magic-attack premise is contradicted by this passive record.

opportunities.name: Powerball AP dive
opportunities.objective: Test powerball ap dive against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Powerball carries 1.0 AP magic damage and Soaring Slam 0.6 AP; casting R during Q adds the Powerball hit at center. Rocketbelt supports arrival angle while Abyssal improves nearby magic damage taken, but E's 0.7 AP damage is explicitly monster-only.
opportunities.requiredState: Land the R center while Q is active.
opportunities.failure: Missing tank resistances leaves Rammus fragile after the short burst.
opportunities.test: Compare plain R versus Q-assisted centered R on a champion.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E does not become champion AP damage merely because its monster damage has an AP ratio.

ruledOut.reason: The old armor-to-magic-attack premise is contradicted by this passive record.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

testPlan: Required state: W active with a target forced to attack by E.
Record AD before W, during W and after Jak'Sho then measure three attacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Without attack speed from old E assumptions, target access limits the damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The old armor-to-magic-attack premise is contradicted by this passive record.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Jak'Sho, The Protean, Blade of The Ruined King, Terminus, Randuin's Omen, Force of Nature, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
